senses.gloss:
f. (-मा)
1 The wife of the monkey SUGRĪVA.
2 The district, or more properly the salt mines of Sambhar, a town in Ajmer, twenty miles west of Jayanagar.
E.
रु to weep, मन् aff., with टाप् fem. aff., deriv. irr.

m. (-म्रः)
ARUṆA, or the dawn.
E.
रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. रव्, and रु substituted for the initial.
